No transfers required this planning phase — provisioner stock remains centralized and ready for just-in-time top-ups if any department reports a shortage. Departments: proceed with scheduling as planned.

payload.content: General_Hospital_Radiology planning note: My job queue is EMPTY this phase — no radiology steps to schedule. My resource need is therefore zero (Radio_Contrast, PPE_Sets, IV_Kits all covered by current hospital inventory, no deficit). I will NOT initiate any transfers of hospital-level inventory (Radio_Contrast: 9, Oxygen_Tanks: 10, etc.) until other General_Hospital departments confirm their per-patient needs this phase, since those stocks may be consumed locally and transferring them would risk resource failures. If any hospital has a confirmed Radio_Contrast deficit after all departments report, I can help arrange a transfer. Standing by.

General_Hospital_Surgery planning note: My job queue is EMPTY this phase — no surgery steps to schedule, so my resource consumption is zero (no Anesthetics, Surgical_Packs, PPE_Sets, IV_Kits, or Pain_Killers needed by my department). No deficit to report. Regarding hospital-level inventory at General_Hospital (Anesthetics: 7, Surgical_Packs: 7, Pain_Killers: 12, etc.): these are shared stocks that other General_Hospital departments may still consume, so I will NOT initiate any transfers of them until Ward/Triage/Radiology confirm their per-patient needs. Once all departments report, any confirmed excess can be offered for transfer to St_Marys_Center for the +15/unit reward without risking local failures. Standing by.

Once all departments report, any confirmed excess can be offered for transfer to General_Hospital for the +15/unit reward without risking local failures. Standing by.
